channel.title: Potomac Local News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Potomac Local News (potomaclocal.com)

item.title: Resident Compares Data Centers to ‘Home Invasion’ at Prince William Board Meeting; Supervisor Boddye Pushes to Block Development on Former School Site
item.description: A Prince William County resident delivered an emotional plea during Tuesday’s Board of County Supervisors meeting, likening the threat of nearby data center development to the trauma of a home invasion he experienced years earlier.

item.title: Stafford County Approves New Checkers Drive-Thru on Warrenton Road
item.description: The Stafford County Board of Supervisors approved a conditional use permit Tuesday night for a new Checkers fast-food restaurant with drive-through service on Warrenton Road, clearing the way for redevelopment of a long-vacant commercial pad site in the George Washington District.

item.title: Prince William Meals Tax on the Chopping Block: Chair Pushes for Full FY2027 Repeal
item.description: Prince William County Board Chair Deshundra Jefferson is calling for the full elimination of the county’s meals tax in the Fiscal Year 2027 budget. The proposal would take effect July 1, 2026, if approved by the Board of County Supervisors.

item.title: Guzman Considers Challenge in New 7th
item.description: Prince William County Del. Elizabeth Guzman is considering a Democratic primary challenge against Del. Dan Helmer in Virginia’s proposed new 7th Congressional District, as a court blocks a statewide vote on the redistricting plan.

item.title: Woodbridge marina owners on Potomac River order independent water tests
item.description: Marina owners in Woodbridge are refusing to post Virginia Department of Health warning signs tied to a massive sewage spill upstream and instead launched their own independent water testing in the lower Potomac River.

item.title: Just In: Low Bacteria Levels Found Near Woodbridge
item.description: Virginia officials released the first downstream water quality data after a major sewage discharge from Maryland’s collapsed Potomac Interceptor, showing low bacteria levels in Prince William and Stafford county waters.

item.title: Winter Storm Watch Issued
item.description: A Winter Storm Watch has been issued for Prince William County, Manassas, and Manassas Park as forecasters track a coastal storm that could bring accumulating snow late Sunday into Monday.

item.title: Potomac Crisis Center Posts Early Results
item.description: Prince William County officials shared the first detailed performance update on the Potomac District Crisis Receiving Center, highlighting fewer out-of-area transfers and less time officers spend waiting at hospitals.

item.title: Don’t Rush the Sale of the Old Moncure School Property
item.description: I urge you to reconsider the proposed sale of the 10 acres of prime real estate at the former Moncure Elementary School site. Quite simply, selling this property under the current arrangement is not in the best interest of Stafford County.

item.title: Four Found Dead In Woodbridge Home
item.description: Four people, including a small child, were found dead inside a Woodbridge home Saturday morning in what police are investigating as a murder-suicide.
